## Model

We estimate the coefficients $\vb$ of the [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression), which has three parts:

- $Y_i|\vX_i \simind \Ber(\pi(\vX_i))$
- $\pi(\vx) = \expitf{\eta(\vx)}$
- $\eta(\vx) = \vx \cdot \vb$

## Hessian function

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_sec_derive_logistic_hessian.qmd >}}

{{< slidebreak >}}

Setting the [score function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score) to zero gives the [score equation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score-equation):

$$\sumin \cb{\ub{\vx_i}_{(p+1) \times 1} \ub{\paren{y_i - \expitf{\tp{\vx_i}\vb}}}_{1 \times 1} } = \mathbf{0}_{(p+1) \times 1}$$ {#eq-score-logistic}

{{< slidebreak >}}

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_rem_score_no_closed_form.qmd >}}


{{< slidebreak >}}

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_note_newton_raphson.qmd >}}

$$
\esttmp{\theta}
\leftarrow \esttmp{\theta} - \inv{\hessf{\vec y;\esttmp{\theta}}}
\scoref{\vec y;\esttmp{\theta}}
$$

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_note_newton_raphson_trace.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: out-glm-fitting-process
#| code-fold: false

beetles_glm_ungrouped <-
  beetles_long |>
  glm(
    control = glm.control(trace = TRUE),
    formula = outcome ~ dose,
    family = "binomial"
  )
```

{{< include _subfiles/logistic-regression/_note_deviance_trace.qmd >}}

@tbl-beetles-glm-ungrouped and @tbl-beetles-glm-ungrouped-vcov show 
the fitted model and the [covariance matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-cov-vec-x) of the estimates, respectively.
